contract_version_note: Minimum contract version for the baseline issuance of each fixture. slab.thmz is a valid contract 1.0 steady-state baseline and remains readable under 2.1 (current_contract_version 2001). Contract 2.0 added optional THERM result layouts and strict active-boundary validation; 2.1 added HeatFluxStepExchange.csv and WaterFluxStepExchange.csv.

files.name: slab.thmz
files.description: Single-material analytic slab: 2000x1000 mm rectangle, k=1.0 W/(m.K), convection h=10 W/(m2.K) at 20 C (left) and 0 C (right), adiabatic top/bottom; premeshed 4 Q4 / 9 nodes.
files.origin: Generated as an analytic contract 1.0 slab baseline via fairyfly-next-therm model_to_thmz and libraryfemtherm mesh serialization.
files.notes: temperature/flux values repeat per node row (3 columns x 3 rows); checked with abs 1e-6, rel 1e-8.

files.name: transient-native-2.1.thmz
files.origin: Transient native contract 2.1 baseline produced by fairyfly-next-therm and solved by the isolated HygroThermFEM wrapper over THMZ.
files.verification: Contract 2.1 archive/member structure and handoff baseline verified against fairyfly-next-therm.
files.notes: Archive/member structure and handoff baseline only; no THERM release-archive registration, physical-equivalence claim, or full step-exchange physics acceptance. The root contract_version remains the original slab's 1000 issuance version; current_contract_version identifies 2001.
